item.title: The road dips violently to the left, 13th September
item.description:
As you drive down the slip road, most people are doing a fare speed. The road suddenly dips violently towards the outside fencing. and a tree. Your vehicle lurches violently to the left before coming back onto a level surface. It's been like this for a long time and I'm surprised this has not been sorted out.
